title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us
The Morco business has expanded to become Australia's leading supplier of fresh produce to the foodservice sector. With operations spanning Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Townsville, Perth, Adelaide, and Darwin, Morco stands as the only national provider to the foodservice sector in Australia. Our success is built on three essential pillars: our people, our customers, and our growers. Each complements the other seamlessly. We are a national business with a local heart, dedicated to bringing you the very best in fresh produce.
https://www.morcofresh.com.au/our-story/
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join a leading wholesale and distribution business, supporting the delivery of high-quality data solutions that drive operational and commercial decision-making.
In this role, you will design, build, and optimise scalable data pipelines and models, transforming complex and high-volume datasets into reliable, business-ready insights. You’ll play a key role in advancing our modern data platform, with a strong focus on Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) and cloud-based technologies.
This is an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where your expertise will directly impact supply chain efficiency, reporting accuracy, and business performance.
Key Responsibilities
Data Architecture & Modelling
Design and maintain scalable data models for analytics and reporting
Develop and manage Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers
Implement dimensional modelling (Star/Snowflake schemas)
Data Engineering & Pipelines
Build and optimise ETL/ELT pipelines from ERP, CRM, and operational systems
Transform complex and semi-structured data (including JSON) into structured formats
Ensure pipelines are efficient, reliable, and scalable
Data Quality & Performance
Monitor and maintain data integrity across all stages of the pipeline
Optimise SQL queries and data transformations for performance
Support data validation and reconciliation processes
Platform & Migration
Contribute to migration from legacy systems to modern cloud platforms (e.g. Microsoft Fabric)
Enhance performance and scalability of the data environment
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with BI teams and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions
Translate business needs into technical requirements
About You
You are a technically strong and commercially aware Data Engineer who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys solving complex data challenges.
Skills & Experience
5+ years’ experience in data engineering
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience in data modelling
Proficiency in Python and data transformation tools (e.g. Power Query, dbt)
Experience with cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, or similar)
Strong understanding of Medallion architecture and data lakehouse concepts
Experience working with semi-structured data (e.g. JSON)
Exposure to wholesale, distribution, retail, or supply chain environments (highly regarded)
Why Join Us?
Work on modern data platforms and large-scale datasets
Be part of a business undergoing data transformation
Collaborative and supportive team environment
Opportunity to influence how data is used across the organisation
How to Apply
If you’re ready to take the next step in your data engineering career and make a tangible impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now with your CV.
 Please note: We are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this role.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Solve by Talent is partnering with the University of Sydney to recruit a Data Engineer to support the delivery of key Information and Communications Technology program (ICT) initiatives that help shape the future of education, research, and innovation.  
We are currently hiring for two positions within this Data Engineering role. 
Why join the University of Sydney? 
Join one of Australia’s leading universities at a pivotal point of change, where technology is evolving to better support student learning, empower teaching excellence, and enable research delivery at global scale. 
ICT is central to delivering the University’s academic mission. Working across faculties, disciplines, and research communities, you will shape the platforms, services, and partnerships that enable student success, strengthen teaching, and accelerate research impact. 
This work spans both the critical services that keep the University running every day and the ongoing improvement of systems and experiences. 
With strong investment and clear direction, you’ll operate in a large and complex environment where your contribution has visible, meaningful impact across the University. 
You’ll collaborate across academic and professional communities to help shape a more connected and capable University, supporting teaching excellence, research impact, and student success. 
The Opportunity 
As a Data Engineer, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling the University’s modern data platform. 
Working within a newly formed Data Services function, you’ll design data pipelines, establish engineering standards, and help embed Microsoft Fabric as a core capability. You’ll join at a pivotal stage, with the opportunity to shape patterns, define best practice, and leave a lasting impact on how data is used across the University. 
What you’ll do 
Design and deliver scalable data storage and processing solutions to support efficient access to organisational data. 
Build and maintain end-to-end data pipelines that ingest, transform, and load data from multiple sources including APIs, databases, and streaming platforms. 
Enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of data systems by applying techniques such as query optimisation, data structuring, and performance improvements. 
Use distributed processing approaches to handle large-scale data transformation and processing. 
Monitor data systems, investigate issues, and resolve performance or data quality problems to ensure reliable operations. 
Implement appropriate data security and privacy controls across data storage and processing environments. 
What we’re looking for 
Experience designing and delivering modern cloud-based data storage solutions (e.g. data lakes and data warehouses). 
Proven experience building and managing data pipelines across multiple data sources. 
Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing using distributed computing frameworks. 
Strong understanding of data performance optimisation techniques. 
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Git and CI/CD for code and pipeline deployment is highly desirable. 
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and modern data engineering environments, along with data security and privacy best practices. 
Desirable: Microsoft Fabric certifications (DP-600 or DP-700). 
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and communication skills. 
What’s in it for you? 
At the University of Sydney, we support our staff with a range of benefits designed to enhance your career, wellbeing and work-life balance, including: 
Up to 17% superannuation to support your financial future. 
Extremely generous parental leave entitlements. 
Competitive salary with salary packaging options. 
Flexible and hybrid working arrangements. 
Career development and learning opportunities. 
Health and wellbeing programs including Fitness Passport. 
Access to a vibrant, globally recognised university community.

Your work will directly power DingGo’s suite of AI products: damage detection, repair cost estimation, document intelligence, and more. You’ll work closely with our Head of Data, AI & New Products , data scientists, and product squads to ship real AI features into the hands of real customers.

AI/ML Engineering
Computer Vision

Large Language Models (LLMs)
MLOps
Data Science
Python
AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Fargate)
Snowflake

• Minimum two years of hands-on ML/AI engineering experience, including production deployments

• Experience designing and building REST APIs and backend services in Python (e.g. FastAPI)

• Comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-moving product environment with shifting priorities
Key Responsibilities
AI/ML Model Development & Evaluation
• Design, develop, train, and fine-tune computer vision and multimodal ML models
• Build and maintain LLM-powered pipelines for document intelligence, repair estimation, and structured data extraction
• Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for model quality, regression testing, and performance benchmarking
• Implement model observability and drift monitoring to maintain quality in production
• Conduct AI R&D: experiment with new architectures, techniques, and open-source models to advance DingGo’s capabilities
LLM Engineering
• Define the target prompt architecture for LLM-powered features
• Build and maintain guardrails, safety layers, and output validation for LLM features in customer-facing products
• Evaluate and benchmark LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, open- source) to optimise quality and cost
• Manage LLM usage costs and ensure efficient, responsible use of inference compute AI Solution Architecture
• Define and own DingGo’s target-state AI/ML stack, selecting tools, frameworks, and infrastructure components that balance capability, cost, and operational complexity
• Design the optimal architecture for each AI feature: real-time vs. batch, synchronous vs. async, cloud-managed vs. self-hosted
• Evaluate open-source tools (Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MLflow, Ray, etc.) and AWS-native services to build a pragmatic, scalable stack
AI Product Development
• Collaborate closely with Product and Data teams to translate product requirements into AI/ML feature designs
• Embed AI capabilities within DingGo’s SaaS platform, including new standalone AI products for fleets, insurers, and repairers
• Contribute to sprint planning, technical scoping, and delivery estimates for AI features
• Ensure AI features are explainable, auditable, and meet the expectations of enterprise and insurance clients
MLOps & Production Deployment
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML models using BitBucket Pipelines, Docker, and AWS (ECS, Lambda)
• Work with DevOps to deploy and scale AI services in production, with clear runbooks and rollback procedures
• Maintain MLflow (or equivalent) for experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment artefacts
• Manage containerised model serving and inference endpoints optimised for latency and throughput
Monitoring, Security & Cost Management
• Implement production monitoring for model performance, data quality, and system health using AWS CloudWatch and custom dashboards
• Ensure AI systems meet DingGo’s ISO 27001 compliance requirements, including data handling, access controls, and audit logging
• Proactively manage total cost of ownership (TCO) for AI/ML infrastructure, identifying and acting on cost optimisation opportunities
• Maintain high availability SLAs for customer-facing AI features
What Success Looks Like at 12 Months
• Multiple new AI products shipped and live with paying clients across fleet, insurance, and repairer segments
• DingGo’s target-state AI/ML stack is defined, documented, and stood up — providing a clear foundation for the next 2–3 years of product growth
• Model quality metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, latency) are tracked, visible, and consistently improving across core computer vision and LLM features
• A robust MLOps practice in place: repeatable deployment pipelines, model versioning, automated evals, and monitoring from day one
• ISO 27001 compliance maintained across all AI systems, with clear data handling policies and audit trails
• AI infrastructure costs are tracked and optimised, with a clear view of per-product and per-client unit economics
• You’re a trusted technical voice within the business — influencing product direction, architectural decisions, and the team’s engineering culture

Build the technical roadmap for AI-driven, self-serve product insights, working closely with PM, PD, Data Science and other teams to make sure the roadmap reflects what teams actually need.
Shape the architecture and design of the experiments platform to handle Canva's growing scale. Write design docs, run design reviews, and make the big calls on how the system evolves, with a particular focus on improving analysis pipeline reliability and latency. Be the technical north star for the team.
You'll mentor and guide engineers through complex problems, help set a high bar for how we build, and bring strong customer empathy to everything we ship, because our customers are every product team at Canva. Drive cross-team initiatives across Product Platform. Pilot doesn't exist in isolation.
You'll work closely with other platform teams, as well as PM, PD, and Data Science, to make sure our systems fit together and raise the bar company-wide. You're probably a match if Experience developing distributed web applications on the JVM; experience writing Java (experience with other JVM languages such as Scala, Kotlin, etc is a plus). Experience with planning, executing architectural changes, and a creative and conceptual problem-solving approach as opposed to a framework or library focused.
Deep knowledge of computer science and engineering fundamentals: concurrency, data structures, and distributed systems. An understanding of resiliency techniques and patterns like load balancing, throttling, back pressure, and circuit breaking. Experience working in large distributed cloud environments (ideally AWS), experience with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes and Terraform is a plus.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, both written and verbal. You're comfortable working across engineering, PM, PD, and Data Science to bring different perspectives together. Experience facilitating collaboration and fostering positive working relationships between stakeholders and engineers, promoting a culture of trust, respect, and open communication.
Experience guiding and mentoring other engineers, helping unblock technical challenges and being an all-around role model. A genuine curiosity about how AI can transform experimentation, not just as a feature to ship, but as a way to fundamentally change how teams get to insights. Think AI-assisted experiment design, automated analysis, or reducing the time from experiment end to decision.
Experience working with large distributed data processing systems (e.g. Snowflake), with strong SQL and data modelling skills. You'll work closely with data scientists, so experience collaborating with DS is essential in this role. A foundational understanding of core statistical concepts relevant to experimentation is a plus but not required, such as randomisation, statistical inference, power analysis, and natural variation.
You don't need to be a statistician, but if you understand why these things matter it'll help you build systems that produce trustworthy results at scale and collaborate effectively with data scientists. About the team The Experiments team is part of PIE (Product Insights Enablement), a group of engineers, data scientists, and product designers building the internal platforms that help Canva move fast and make confident product decisions.
We own Pilot, Canva's A/B testing and experimentation platform. Pilot is the system that lets every product team at Canva design, launch, and measure experiments, from a 1% rollout to a global feature release. When a Canvanaut wants to know whether a new feature is actually working, or which variant of that feature works best, they're relying on us.
On the engineering side, that means owning the full stack: the statistical engine that calculates experiment results, the analysis service that processes millions of metrics, the data pipelines that keep everything fresh, and the UI that makes results legible for data scientists, engineers, product managers, and designers alike. If you care about getting experimentation right, statistically, operationally, and at scale, this is the place to do it. About the Role
This is a Staff Software Engineer role on the Experiments team, where you will be responsible for shaping the vision of Experiments at Canva. You'll be one of the most experienced engineers in the room, and the team will look to you to raise the bar technically and help everyone grow. Customer empathy is at the core of this role.
You're building systems that product teams across Canva rely on every day, so keeping their needs front and centre shapes every technical decision you make. Your customers are Canvanauts from all kinds of disciplines; data scientists, engineers, designers, product managers, each with their own way of working but all looking for the same thing: a clear answer on their experiment. Key technical challenges include making experimentation faster and more cost-efficient to support rapid idea testing, and evolving the platform for the AI era: Adapting the platform for the AI era, both to enable AI native interactions and enable Canvanauts to iterate at speed ensuring the feedback loop is fast enough to keep pace with teams who are now shipping code at a speed that wasn't possible before.
Improving the reliability of our analysis pipeline. We handle a large volume of data at scale, with a low margin for error, and that bar only gets higher as Canva grows. Making complex things simple.
You'll build experiences that tell teams clearly how their experiment is going and what to do next, while still giving them the depth and detail they need when they want to dig in. In addition to the technical work, you'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and Designers to determine the platform's future direction. You'll work closely with leads across Product Platform, a supergroup with a mission to enable more informed product decisions at Canva's scale.
What's in it for you? Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
Here's a taste of what's on offer: Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info. Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
All interviews are conducted virtually
